composition_label: Feedback analysis (Customer insights) -> Structured extraction (Document automation)

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory.

shared_schema.input: Strict object: schema_version, synthetic=true, citizen_pii declarations, documents, fields. Documents have id, entity, format, content. Extraction fields have name, entity, label, required.
shared_schema.output: Shared envelope: schema_version, synthetic, status, notice, fields, feedback, extraction. Feedback sources carry canonical IDs, original duplicate IDs, entity and redacted text. Extraction carries source IDs, original IDs, themes, fields, missing_fields, review_required and explanation.
shared_schema.validation: validate(value, stage) checks input and both stage boundaries. Extraction is validated against deterministic recomputation from the validated feedback envelope.
shared_schema.spans: Zero-based end-exclusive Python character offsets into redacted source text. Original text is intentionally not retained.
shared_schema.errors: File, decoding and validation errors produce one JSON object with status=error and exit 2, without reflecting sensitive input.

cross_stage_handoffs: Input -> feedback: validate strict synthetic schema; redact declared PII, recognizable contact/ID patterns and explicitly labeled personal fields.
Feedback -> extraction: validate the envelope; consume only redacted canonical sources, duplicate aliases, themes and the shared field specifications. No second read of raw input.
Extraction -> output: validate field values, missing reports and inherited evidence against the same feedback source records.

behavior.deduplication: Same entity plus normalized case/whitespace of complete redacted document text. Retain the first redacted source and all original IDs. Different entities never merge. This is document-level deduplication, not semantic similarity.
behavior.themes: Deterministic keyword-prefix matching with exact supporting line excerpts. Unmatched Feedback lines become Other feedback. Topic classification is not sentiment, factual endorsement or an administrative decision.
behavior.extraction: Literal schema label followed by a colon at line start, case-insensitive. Copy trimmed text only. Multiple occurrences are ambiguous even if their values match. No inferred values or eligibility determinations.
behavior.missing_reporting: Every applicable absent, empty, ambiguous or protected field is reported, including optional fields. Required missing fields set review_required. Protected values have no extracted value or span.
behavior.public_sector_safeguards: Demonstrative data minimization and PII removal, traceable excerpts and source spans for open-records review, plain-language notices and human review. No Privacy Act, GDPR, FOIA or Section 508 certification claims.
behavior.synthetic_data: Invented citizen, SYNTH case numbers, example.invalid email and non-traceable invented address; no real government policy.

test_outcomes.observed: All 19 unittest cases passed. The example CLI printed one valid JSON object; four input documents produced three canonical extraction records and one duplicate.
